verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents API-token access to its JMAP API (docs-5, docs-40). It also stresses that JMAP is an open, fully documented, patent-free standard covering mail, contacts and calendars as a lock-in-free replacement for IMAP/CardDAV/CalDAV (docs-21, docs-42, docs-49, docs-23). That gives a standards-based path to pull data out, but the pack contains no documented one-click or full-account export feature. The only community migration evidence is about moving into Fastmail, so leaving is implied, not shown. Missing for 10: a documented full-account export tool, explicit export file formats (e.g., mbox/EML, vCard, iCalendar), coverage of non-mail data such as filters, rules and settings, and hands-on evidence of migrating away from Fastmail.
